basis: Current source expressions parsed by TypeScript AST. No browser was launched; no runtime element or state receives PASS.

included: custom control component call sites and finite mount paths
scope.boundary: Portal destinations /games, /friends and sign-in are external shared UI. Their link controls here are inventoried; their destination pages are not silently counted as scanned.

idPolicy: file + owner + tag/label/handler/conditions semantic hash; source blob hashes and UTF-16 ranges resolve the exact occurrence. Lines are convenience only.
dynamicPolicy: A source template is not a runtime count. Expand each repeat and component call site over its stated source/runtime domain; never invent participant, item, socket, friend or room IDs.
analysisLimits: Label expressions preserve source text and RU/EN alternatives; they are not a browser-computed accessible-name audit.
Conditions are lexical ancestor branches, not a proof that a state is reachable. Read the source owner for preceding early returns and indirect guards.
Handler action types are direct AST literals and resolved local declarations; dynamic actions flow through component props and serverInteractionTemplates.
The template census includes display-only call sites of an otherwise interactive component, such as the minimap, and explicitly marks those call sites.

onKeyDown.expression: event => { if (!onMark) return; const current = cursor ?? mark ?? view.map.start; if (['Enter', 'Space'].includes(event.code)) { event.preventDefault(); onMark(roadPoint(view, current.x, current.z)); } else if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight'].includes(event.code)) { event.preventDefault(); const step = event.shiftKey ? 5 : 2; setCursor({ x: Math.max(0, Math.min(width, current.x + (event.code === 'ArrowRight' ? step : event.code === 'ArrowLeft' ? -step : 0))), y: current.y, z: Math.max(0, Math.min(height, current.z + (event.code === 'ArrowDown' ? step : event.code === 'ArrowUp' ? -step : 0))) }); } }

onClick.expression: event => { if (!onMark) return; const point = event.currentTarget.createSVGPoint(); point.x = event.clientX; point.y = event.clientY; const matrix = event.currentTarget.getScreenCTM(); if (!matrix) return; const local = point.matrixTransform(matrix.inverse()); const value = roadPoint(view, local.x, local.y); setCursor(value); onMark(value); }
